title: Interweaving Destinies
next_chapter_hook: The secret realm's opening three months later would become a pivotal moment that changes everything—and Chen Ling's parting words, like a massive boulder thrown into a deep pond, had sent ripples spreading quietly, pointing toward a truth deliberately buried.

text.content:
Night as dark as ink, deep within the bamboo grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, bamboo leaves rustled as if whispering unspeakable secrets.

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back before the thatched cottage, fingers pinching the letter from the imperial court, his knuckles slightly white from the pressure. He had read the characters on the letter more than ten times, each word like a branding iron, searing his heart.

The mystery of the dragon's veins, his father's遗物, his sister's silhouette... Three threads that should have had nothing to do with each other were now like three intertwined silk strands, slowly twisting into a force he could not ignore.

"Are you spacing out again?" The aged voice rang in his mind, carrying impatience. "How many times have I told you, nighttime is the best time for cultivation, yet here you are sighing over a bunch of worthless papers all day."

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, you're quite the悠闲 one." Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, his tone carrying a hint of teasing. "If I remember correctly, you sleep more soundly than anyone during the day. Why the sudden energy at night? Could it be that remnant souls also suffer from insomnia?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice immediately caught, after a moment he snorted: "You lad, your tongue's gotten sharper. That was me conserving energy, understand?" He paused, his tone suddenly turning grave. "However, tonight... something does feel off. There's a very faint spiritual energy fluctuation in the air, as if someone is watching from the shadows."

dialogue.content: "I know." Chen Ji said calmly, his gaze still on the letter in his hands. "It's been happening for half an hour now. Friend hiding behind the third bamboo stalk to the east, since you're here, why not show yourself? Lurking in the dark eavesdropping isn't exactly honorable conduct."

text.content:
As the words fell, the bamboo grove fell into dead silence. Even the night wind seemed to halt at this moment, only the occasional cricket chirp from afar proving this wasn't an illusion.

A moment later, a slender figure emerged slowly from the bamboo shadows. Moonlight pierced through the gaps in the bamboo leaves, falling upon the newcomer, illuminating a clear yet pale face—a face bearing some resemblance to Chen Ji's.

Chen Ji's heart clenched violently.

That face, those eyes... He had seen them in countless midnight dreams, had caught that faint outline in the blurry prophetic visions from the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Brother." The newcomer called softly, her voice hoarse with a hint of choking. "I'm back."

text.content:
Chen Ji stood motionless on the spot. Under the moonlight, his expression was calm to the point of coldness, only a faint ripple stirring in the depths of his eyes.

Chen Ling. Chen Nian. So they really were the same person.

He had once used the Tianji Record to foresee her figure, yet every time could only see a blurry outline—because she was that "existence that disrupts the Tianji Record," his sister who was taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock."

And now, here she stood before him, alive.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ling." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice low. "No, I should call you Chen Nian. The Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Lock,' the missing young lady of the Chen family—you're more capable than I imagined, actually finding your way here. Go on then, what do you want from me?"

text.content:
Upon hearing this, the glimmer of tears in Chen Nian's eyes faltered, as if she hadn't expected a reunion to unfold like this. She bit her lip, forcing down the sourness in her heart, and withdrew an ancient jade slip from her sleeve.

"I know what you're searching for." She took a deep breath. "About Father, about the Tianji Record, about... your origins. This jade slip contains information about the Ancient Forbidden Land. In three months, the forbidden land will open."

dialogue.content: "Wait!" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly erupted in Chen Ji's mind, carrying unprecedented gravity. "The aura on this jade slip... I recognize it! This is... the aura of the previous Tianji Record master! Boy, this matter is far more complicated than you think!"

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, his expression betraying nothing while his heart churned with terrifying waves. The previous Tianji Record master—that was an existence even more ancient than Mo Xiansheng, and also the truth he had been trying to pursue all along.

He walked forward slowly, taking the jade slip. The moment it touched his palm, a familiar yet foreign aura spread along his fingertips, as if something deep within his blood was gently stirring.

This aura...

dialogue.content: "This aura is the same as that jade pendant in Father's study." Chen Nian seemed to read his confusion, saying softly. "Brother, do you know why Father named you 'Chen Ji'? Ji is the机 of天机, heavenly secrets. And you... from the very beginning, were never an ordinary person."

text.content:
The air in the bamboo grove seemed to solidify. Chen Ji's hand holding the jade slip tightened slightly, his knuckles making faint sounds from the excessive force.

Not ordinary? Heh, ever since the day he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, these words had echoed countless times in his mind. But he had never imagined the answer would be revealed in such a way.

He raised his head, his gaze falling on Chen Nian's face, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Speak clearly."

dialogue.content: "Father... he wasn't your biological father." As Chen Nian spoke these words, her eyes had already reddened. "You are the bloodline left behind by the previous Tianji Record master, the child adopted by Father. Your true name... should be Chen Tianji."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of his origins, Chen Ji needed to respond

choices.text: Calm on the surface, secretly verifying
choices.description: Calmly accepting the information, using the Tianji Record to verify the truth of Chen Nian's words, while maintaining covert probing of Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points for verification
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues to the truth of his origins
choices.risk_hint: If verification proves false, it may alert the target

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment warmed faintly in the depths of his consciousness, and a blurry image began to emerge—yet just as Chen Nian had said, any prophecy involving her was shrouded in obscurity.

text.content: But this time, he saw something different. In that blurry vision, there was a man's back gazing at him, that figure holding a jade pendant in hand—precisely the one among his father's遗物. And that man's aura was exactly the same as what he had felt when touching the jade slip.

choices.description: Expressing shock and anger at what Chen Nian said, his worldview built over many years shattered, needing an outlet
choices.visible_reward: Press Chen Nian to reveal more hidden details
choices.risk_hint: May play right into someone's hands

dialogue.content: Chen Ji clenched his fist tightly, his knuckles cracking. "Chen Tianji?" His voice suddenly rose, carrying years of suppressed anger. "You say I'm not of Chen blood? Do you know how I've gotten through all these years——"

Chen Nian didn't flinch; instead, she stepped forward, tears glistening in her eyes but her gaze firm. "I know! That's why I must tell you the truth! Brother——no, Chen Ji... The Holy Sect took me away to study the bloodline within you!"

choices.text: Bears grudges but not reckless, coldly watches
choices.description: Stores all information in his heart, shows nothing on the surface, continues playing the "waste", while secretly laying plans
choices.visible_reward: Make Chen Nian lower her guard, get her to reveal more crucial information
choices.risk_hint: May miss the chance for emotional breakthrough

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly loosening his fists. A moment later, his face returned to that indifferent, calm expression, as if the emotional fluctuation had merely been an illusion.

Chen Ji continued: "Since that's the case, let's talk about the Forbidden Grounds. It opens in three months——you specially came to tell me this, surely not just to send me to my death." His tone was calm, yet carried a certainty of seeing through everything.

Chen Nian looked at him, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes——there was relief, and also heartache. Her brother, indeed, was still that Chen Ji who could maintain composure no matter what happened. "Within the Forbidden Grounds lies the key to the complete form of the Tianji Record. And you... must grow stronger before then."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time with barely concealed excitement: "The complete form of the Tianji Record... So that's it! This old man finally understands! Boy, do you know why this old man can only exist as a remnant soul? Because the Tianji Record is incomplete!"

dialogue.content: This old man's former master, to seal some terrifying power, split the Tianji Record into nine parts. Each part seals a fragment of power. And the location of that seal... is within the Ancient Forbidden Land opening in three months!

text.content:
Chen Ji heard this, and a great wave surged in his heart. The Tianji Record split into nine——this meant the fragment in his hands was only one-ninth. And the consumption of his Heavenly Fate, the weakness after each use, were likely related to this incompleteness.

If he could gather all nine pages...

He raised his head, looking at Chen Nian, a sharp glint flickering in his gaze: "You investigated these things during your years at the Holy Sect?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian shook her head, a bitter smile appearing on her pale face. "Not investigated. I was told." She paused. "The Holy Sect captured me, not just because I'm your sister. They needed a vessel——a vessel capable of containing the aura of the Tianji Record."

All these years, I underwent countless experiments at the Holy Sect. They injected the aura of the Tianji Record into my body, trying to make me a new 'Tianji Record vessel.'" Her voice began to tremble. "But they failed. Because the only one who can truly resonate with the Tianji Record... is you.

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Countless experiments.

An image flickered in his mind: a frail figure bound in the center of a cold formation, surrounded by blinding spiritual light and scorching pain...

A wave of murderous intent surged in his heart, but he死死压制住. His fingers trembled slightly, yet he maintained his calm expression.

Bears grudges but not reckless. He silently recited. Now is not the time.

dialogue.content: "So you're back now because the Holy Sect is preparing to make a move on you?" Chen Ji's voice was very soft, as if squeezed through his teeth. "Or perhaps... you've actually never been free of their control?"

Chen Nian's expression shifted slightly, but she didn't deny it. "You're right." She lowered her head. "In the eyes of the Holy Sect, I've always been a golden oriole. But this golden oriole... also has her own wings." She raised her head, her gaze firm. "The opening of the Forbidden Grounds in three months is our only opportunity."

text.content: She took out a yellowed map from her bosom, covered with密密麻麻 routes and runes. "This is what I risked my life to bring out. The entrance to the Forbidden Grounds lies deep within the Northern Domain Ice Plain, and three keys are needed to open it. And these three keys..." She pointed to three marks on the map. "Are held by the three major sects."

dialogue.content: "Three major sects..." Chen Ji repeated softly, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Interesting. It seems this chess game is much bigger than I imagined." He raised his head, looking at Chen Nian. "Since you dared to come see me, you must have a plan. Go ahead, what do you want me to do?"

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Nian's cooperation proposal, Chen Ji needs to make a choice

choices.description: No matter what, she was still the sister raised by the Chen family, and the only lead at the moment—he would take the risk and trust her once
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Nian's full support and obtain inside intelligence from the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian is controlled, he may lose everything

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long moment before finally speaking: 'Alright. Since you say the key to unlocking the Tianji Record lies within the Forbidden Grounds, then in these three months, I will make the three great sects willingly deliver that key to me.'

text.content: His tone was calm, yet carried a chilling self-assurance. This was the confidence of 'waste' Chen Ji—a man who navigated the chaotic world torn apart by the three great sects and the Demonic Path, walking the world through chess.

choices.description: Agree to cooperate, but secretly leave a backup plan, having Mo Xiansheng monitor Chen Nian's every move
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence while keeping an escape route
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, trust will greatly diminish

dialogue.content: Chen Ji nodded, yet in his heart, he quietly transmitted a message to Mo Xiansheng: 'Sir, please keep a close watch on her. If there are any abnormalities...' He didn't finish, but the meaning was already clear.

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, as if sizing up Chen Nian, then said: 'There is indeed something peculiar about the aura on this girl... I will keep watch.' After a pause, he added, 'However, from what I can see now, what she said should be true.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt slightly relieved, though his expression remained unchanged: 'Three months is indeed urgent. Since that's the case, starting now, we need to formulate a detailed plan.'

choices.description: Rely on no one else, investigate the Forbidden Grounds intelligence alone, and set up the situation for three months later in his own way
choices.visible_cost: Lose this important lead from Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment, not controlled by anyone

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his tone indifferent yet resolute: 'Your intelligence is valuable, but as for cooperation... let's not for now.' He looked at the slight disappointment in Chen Nian's eyes and added, 'It's not that I don't trust you, but I don't want to drag you any deeper.'

A flash of hurt appeared in Chen Nian's eyes, but was quickly replaced by determination. 'I knew you wouldn't easily trust anyone.' she said softly, 'But brother... Chen Ji, three months later, I will be waiting for you on the Northern Realm Ice Plains. Whether you come or not... I will be there.'

text.content: With that, she turned and vanished into the depths of the Bamboo Grove, her figure quickly swallowed by the night. Only a faint, lingering fragrance remained where she had stood, proving this was no illusion.

The night wind blew past, rustling the leaves. Chen Ji stood still, his gaze deep and profound as he stared toward where Chen Nian had disappeared.

Three months. Three keys. Three great sects.

And that so-called 'previous owner of the Tianji Record'—his biological father.

All the clues point to the same direction: the Northern Realm Ice Plains, the Ancient Forbidden Land, three months from now.

dialogue.content: Kid, what are you planning to do?' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, carrying a hint of amusement, 'The three great sects are not easy to deal with. Especially that number one genius Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect—when you made him lose face last time, he's probably burning with anger right now.

text.content:
A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, carrying a meaningful expression.

Han Lie? That brainless blockhead with nothing but brute strength? If the last lesson wasn't enough, then he'd let him lose again.

He turned and walked back to the thatched cottage, taking out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. On the pitch-black surface, ancient runes gleamed with a ghostly light under the moonlight.

Three months—enough time for him to do many things.

dialogue.content: Just then, Chen Ji suddenly stopped in his tracks. He turned his head and softly spoke into the seemingly empty depths of the Bamboo Grove: "By the way, relay a message to the Holy Sect—whatever they owe my sister, I will collect with interest."

text.content:
The voice was soft, yet sufficient for someone hidden in the shadows to hear. After a moment, a faint rustle came from the depths of the Bamboo Grove, then all returned to dead silence.

Chen Ji didn't look back, walking straight back to the thatched cottage. He knew that from this night onward, the thin veil between him and the Holy Sect had been completely torn apart.

And this was only the beginning.

dialogue.content: Just as he was about to step over the threshold, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a peculiar tone: "Boy, that sentence you just said... Chen Ling heard it. However, before she left, she also said something else. This old man didn't want to tell you originally, but seeing your pretentious appearance, I might as well say it."

text.content:
Chen Ji froze mid-step, slowly turning around. Moonlight fell upon his face, revealing a pair of eyes as deep and dark as ink.

What words?

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his voice becoming unusually grave: "She said—your destiny was rewritten once from the very beginning."

These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind.

A rewritten destiny?

He unconsciously clenched his fists. Seventeen years of being a废物, countless moments of humiliation and mockery, all those days he thought he was deliberately enduring... Could it be that from the very beginning, someone had been manipulating everything behind the scenes?

He raised his head, gazing at the bright moon hanging high, his eyes growing increasingly sharp.

No matter who is manipulating this game of chess, he would overturn it with his own hands.

Night deepened, and in the Bamboo Grove of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, a solitary figure stood quietly.

The three-month countdown had begun.

Within these three months, he would make the three great sects willingly hand over the keys, make the Holy Sect pay for their deeds, and most importantly, uncover the truth behind this so-called "destiny rewriting."

The Northern Realm Ice Plains, the Ancient Forbidden Land, the complete form of the Tianji Record... all the answers awaited him there.

Chen Ji turned and walked into the thatched cottage, its pitch-black door slowly closing behind him, sealing out the cold, clear moon.

Three months later, the game of destiny would finally be revealed.
